author: musho7-dev
subject: Fix touch scrolling in garage and workshop lists
body:
- Buttons pass touches through, so a swipe that starts on a car or part
  scrolls the list instead of being swallowed by the button
- A press only counts as a tap if the finger moved less than 14 px;
  scrolling no longer selects the car under your finger
- Movement is tracked per finger, so a second finger doesn't disturb it
- Help and pause buttons get a multitouch area so they work with a
  second finger while the first holds GAS
